'''Operation Thunderbolt''' was an operation undertaken by the [[Sullustan Resistance]] under [[Gaff Kilvaari]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The goal of the mission was to disrupt the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] aligned&ndash;[[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] operations in [[G'rinn Go city]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

The Operation had four primary targets: an [[AgriSuub research facility]], the [[G'rinn Go city corporate security HQ]], the [[SoroSuub land systems and proving grounds]], and a [[SoroSuub secure uplink station]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
